pinReason: AA Desktop 2.0.3 (the latest published release) discovers the DSH bridge only through the HTTP endpoint at ~/.agents-anywhere/dsh-bridge/endpoint.json. Upstream main moved the bridge to meshcall 0.3.0, which writes connector.json and no longer publishes endpoint.json, so a bridge built from main can never connect to a published AA Desktop. Clear this pin once AA ships a Desktop release that reads connector.json.
manifestChanges: release staging removes prepack/postpack hooks; build, typecheck and check:build run explicitly
release staging pins the AA build-time DSH type graph to the source devDependencies
